note: Adapted from the soldier description in Ahmad 1965, Termites (Isoptera) of Thailand (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History 131: 1—113), originally in English. The material package contains only the soldier caste, with no descriptions of the alate or worker. The original records the distribution as 3 km east of Ka-Chong (under cattle dung) and Tung Sa-Lang Luang (in fallen wood), collected in months 3—4 of 1962. No OCR defects affecting the readings were found.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head nearly rectangular; mandibles long and stout, hooked at the apex; the left mandible with a conspicuous, broad-based, transversely directed tooth in the middle; the right mandible toothless, although some specimens have an indistinct small tooth; antennae 17-segmented, segment 2 1.5 times as long as segment 3. The middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum is slightly concave and the middle of the posterior margin weakly concave, the lateral margins broadly rounded; the pronotal pilosity is denser than that of the head.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head pale reddish brown; mandibles dark brown; antennae brown; pronotum yellow. Hairs of the head sparse; the labrum has a row of long setae along each side; the submentum bears 2 setae near its anterior end; the pronotal pilosity is denser than that of the head. Head nearly rectangular. Labrum slightly longer than wide, narrowly rounded at the apex. Mandibles long and stout, hooked at the apex; the left mandible with a conspicuous, broad-based, transversely directed tooth in the middle; the right mandible toothless, although some specimens have an indistinct small tooth. Submentum elongate, slightly bow-shaped; its lateral margins slightly concave before the middle and convex in the basal third; greatest width in the basal third. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 2 1.5 times as long as segment 3; segment 4 slightly longer than segments 3 and 5. The middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum is slightly concave; the middle of the posterior margin weakly concave; the lateral margins broadly rounded.

Measurements (10 soldiers; range, mean in parentheses): head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 2.70—2.96 mm (2.89); head width (at the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.45—1.61 mm (1.52); head width (at the posterior lateral end of the antennal carinae) 1.97—2.13 mm (2.06); maximum head width 2.23—2.60 mm (2.37); left mandible length 1.40—1.56 mm (1.45); distance from the left mandibular tooth to the apex 0.75—0.78 mm (0.77); submentum length 1.71—1.92 mm (1.83); submentum width 0.83—0.93 mm (0.86); pronotal length 0.83—0.88 mm (0.86); pronotal width 1.61—1.82 mm (1.68).
